definitions.explanation: placing military forces, equipment, or resources in strategic positions for use

examples.japanese: ⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{配備|はいび}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配備|はいび}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Troops were stationed near the border.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦闘機|せんとうき}→戦闘機：23287_sentouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配備|はいび}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It has been decided that new fighter jets will be deployed to this base.

notes:
Composed of {配|はい} (distribute, arrange) + {備|び} (equip, prepare). Primarily a military term for placing forces or weapons in strategic locations. Also used more broadly for deploying equipment or resources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配備|はいび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deploy forces
- ⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配備|はいび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deploy missiles
- {配備|はいび}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: deployment plan
- ⟦{前方|ぜんぽう}→前方：19125_zenpou⟧{配備|はいび}: forward deployment
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧{配備|はいび}: nuclear deployment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧: arrangement, positioning — more general; can refer to arranging people or things in any context
- ⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧: deployment, development — also used for military operations but has broader meanings
- ⟦{駐留|ちゅうりゅう}→駐留：23159_chuuryuu⟧: stationing (of troops) — implies a longer-term presence in a location
